Game Overview

Max Crusher 2 - Destruction Drift and Racing! is a racing game built around quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

The moment-to-moment gameplay in Max Crusher 2 - Destruction Drift and Racing! is easy to pick up. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Max Crusher 2 - Destruction Drift and Racing!?

Max Crusher 2 - Destruction Drift and Racing! is a free racing game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Yes, Max Crusher 2 - Destruction Drift and Racing! is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
